judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

K. Murali Shankar, J.:— The second appeal is directed against the common judgment and decree, dated 10-7-2013 passed in A.S. Nos. 58 and 59 of 2012 on the file of the VI Additional District Court, Madurai, confirming the judgment and decree, dated 12-10-2012 passed in O.S. No. 294 of 2011 on the file of the II Additional Sub Court, Madurai.

2. The learned counsel appearing for the appellants circulated a letter to the Registry, dated 9-3-2026, seeking permission of this Court to withdraw this appeal and he has also made an endorsement to that effect.

3. The learned counsel appearing for the respondent is present.

4. Permission is granted. In view of the above, this section appeal is dismissed as withdrawn. Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed. No costs.
